about: Scenarios of the song worker's GPU mechanism over time, recorded by workers/tests/test_gpu_table.py (see docs/design/v5-gpu.md). Times are simulated seconds from the job's start. `setup` is what the simulation was given (speech workers: [MB, offload s, reload s]; people: [t, in_voice, listeners, live]; the speech workers and Core are models, not their code). `events` are, in order: a change of what is observed (stage, exclusive, window, running, yield_pauses, each speech worker's state), an HTTP call the song worker makes with its reply, a decision the job records (mode/code, deduplicated as the job does), and the script's own events (core, card, worker).
